blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Linters are widely used in code maintenance and real-time IDE editing to surface lint alerts related to performance, style, error-prone, and other patterns in source files. However, existing code benchmarks do not explicitly evaluate linter-guided file refactoring, where models must reduce lint alerts in source files with correct initial functionality while satisfying functionality preservation. We introduce LintEval, a multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring across C++, Python, and Java, comprising 13,061 programs with correct initial functionality and 171,662 lint alerts extracted using language-specific linters. LintEval jointly evaluates functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality. Experiments reveal a persistent trade-off: closed-source commercial models reach up to 90.4% Reduction@P but achieve only 67.1%-68.3% Pass@1, while several open-source small models show low or negative Reduction@P. A controlled fine-tuning study further shows that supervision format matters: refactoring-oriented SFT raises Qwen2.5-Coder-7B Reduction@P from 24.7% to 76.0%. LintEval enables controlled evaluation of models that improve source files under functionality preservation.

LintEval联合评价功能保存,lint提醒减少,新的提醒避免,编辑最小化. 实验揭示了持久的权衡:封闭源码商业模型达到90.4%的减少量@ P但仅实现67.1%-68.3%的Pass@1,而多个开源小模型显示低或负还原@P. 一项有控制的微调研究进一步表明,监督格式很重要:重构面向SFT的SFT将Quen2.5-Coder-7B的降幅从24.7%提高到76.0%. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced many software-engineering tasks ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Hui et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Existing code benchmarks assess them through code generation from specifications ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Tong and Zhang, 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Uniyal et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , automated debugging and repair ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2024 ; Bui et al., 2022 ) , and non-functional requirements or refactoring beyond functional correctness ( Singhal et al., 2024 ; Gautam et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)推进了许多软件工程任务(杨等,2025;回等,2024;王等,2024. 现有代码基准通过从规格生成代码来评估(Chen等人,2021年;Jain等人,2025年;Tong和Zhang,2018年)。 ; 2024; Huang等, 2024; Uniyal等, 2024; He等, 2024; Wang等, 2023; ),自动调试和修理(张等, 2026; 钟等, 2024; Tian等, 2024; Bui等, 2022;), 以及功能正确性以外的不起作用要求或重构(Singhal等, 2024; Gautam等, 2025.).

blocks.en:
Within the scope of functionality-preserving refactoring, linter-guided file refactoring remains under-explored despite its direct connection to developer workflows.
Linters identify performance inefficiencies, style violations, and fine-grained risks within source files, and resolving these file-level alerts helps maintain code health and reduce technical debt ( Christakis and Bird, 2016 ; Tómasdóttir et al., 2020 ; Zampetti et al., 2017 ; Beller et al., 2016 ; Borg et al., 2024 ) .
Because many alerts require context-sensitive changes, they provide a controlled setting for testing whether LLMs can resolve code-quality issues beyond fixed rule-based transformations ( Venkatesh et al., 2024 ; Al-Bataineh and Moonen, 2022 ) .
However, despite the increasing use of static-analysis and code-quality feedback to improve model outputs ( Dolcetti et al., 2026 ; Robeyns and Aitchison, 2025 ) , existing benchmarks fail to jointly evaluate functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality.
blocks.zh:
在功能保留重构的范围内,l-介导文件重构尽管与开发者的工作流程直接相通,但仍然没有得到充分的探索.
Linters在源文档中识别出性能效率低下,风格违规,以及细微受损的风险,并解决了这些文件级别提示有助于维持代码健康并减少技术债务(Christakis and Bird, 2016;Tómasdóttir等, 2020;Zampetti等, 2017; Beller等, 2016; Borg等, 2024).
由于许多警报需要针对上下文的修改,它们为测试LLM能否在基于固定规则的转换之外解决代码质量问题提供了一个控制设置(Venkatesh等,2024;Al-Bataineh和Mounen,2022.).
然而,尽管越来越多地使用静态分析和代码质量反馈来改进模型输出(Dolcetti等人,2026年;Robeyns和Aitchison,2025年),但现有基准未能联合评价功能保存、减少提示、避免新的提示和编辑最小度。

blocks.en: We introduce LintEval , a large-scale, multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring (Figure 1 , Table 1 ). To support rigorous functionality preservation, we curate 13,061 files across C++, Python, and Java from CodeContests+ ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , using algorithmic tasks not to mimic all production settings but to obtain high-coverage test oracles that detect subtle functionality preservation failures. Within these files, we identify 171,662 lint alerts.
blocks.zh: 我们引入 LintEval , 一个大型的多语言基准,用于介导文件重构(图1,表1)。 为了支持严格的功能保存,我们从CodeContests+(Wang等,2025年)对13,061个C++,Python,和Java的文档进行校验,使用算法任务不模仿所有生产设置,而是获得高覆盖测试甲板来检测微妙的功能保存故障. 在这些文件中,我们发现 171,662升警报。

blocks.en: We evaluate representative closed-source commercial and open-source models alongside rule-based baselines, and find that linter-guided file refactoring remains challenging for current models. Rule-based baselines resolve only 25.9% of lint alerts, while closed-source commercial models prioritize lint alert reduction at the cost of functionality preservation, introducing functional regressions in over 31% of samples; a pronounced cross-lingual disparity also persists (e.g., DeepSeek-v3.2 falls from 76.6% Reduction@P on C++ to 63.7% on Java). A controlled fine-tuning study shows that explicit lint alerts in the training format, rather than exposure to cleaner code alone, are central to this capability: refactoring-oriented supervision raises Qwen2.5-Coder-7B from 24.7% to 76.0% Reduction@P.
blocks.zh: 我们评价具有代表性的封闭源码商业模型和开源模型以及基于规则的基线,发现对目前的模型来说,互导文件重构仍然具有挑战性。 基于规则的基线只解决了25.9%的林特警示,而闭源商业模型则以功能保存为代价优先减少林特警示,在超过31%的样本中引入了功能回归;明显的跨语言差异也持续存在(例如,DeepSeek-v3.2从76.6%的C++上降为63.7%). 一项有控制的微调研究表明,培训格式的明确提示,而不是仅仅接触更清洁的代码,是这一能力的核心:重构导向的监督。 Quen2.5-Coder-7B从24.7%降至76.0% 递减@P.

blocks.en: Core contributions are summarized as follows: • Benchmark: We introduce LintEval , a large-scale, multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring, featuring 13,061 files and 171,662 lint alerts to evaluate lint alert reduction by LLMs under strict functionality preservation. • Empirical Analysis: Through extensive evaluation of representative models and training settings, we map model boundaries: closed-source commercial models prioritize lint alert reduction over functionality preservation, while open-source models show cross-language and alert-category weaknesses. • Fine-Tuning Study: We demonstrate that while generation-oriented training does not reliably improve linter-guided file refactoring, refactoring-oriented data formatting substantially narrows the gap between open-source models and closed-source commercial models on this task.

blocks.en: 2 LintEval Construction
blocks.zh: 2 LintEval 建筑工程

blocks.en: LintEval is built through a controlled pipeline for evaluating linter-guided file refactoring. As illustrated in Figure 1 , we curate initial source files exclusively from programs with correct initial functionality under high-coverage test oracles, establishing a reliable baseline to validate subsequent functionality preservation. We then deploy industry-standard static analyzers across C++, Python, and Java, normalizing heterogeneous lint alerts into a unified taxonomy.
blocks.zh: LintEval是通过一个可控管道来构建的,用于评价l-guided文件重构. 如图1所示,我们专门从高覆盖测试甲骨文下具有正确初始功能的程序对初始源文件进行整理,为验证随后的功能保存建立了可靠的基线. 然后我们在整个C++、Python和Java 部署工业标准静态分析器, 将不同的线粒体警报正常化成一个统一的分类。

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Sourcing and Functional Validation
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据测定和功能验证

blocks.en:
We source files and test suites from CodeContests+ ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , which expands test volume to uncover subtle functional regressions.
Each problem provides 50–200 test cases, giving high-coverage oracles that establish correct initial functionality and detect functionality preservation failures after refactoring.
blocks.zh:
我们源代码Contests+(Wang等,2025年)的文档和测试套件,扩展了测试量以发现微妙的功能回归.
每个问题提供50-200个测试案例,给出高覆盖的甲骨文,建立正确的初始功能并检测出功能保存在重构后会出故障.

blocks.en: 2.2 Multi-Language Alert Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.2 多语言警报提取器

blocks.en:
LintEval identifies lint alerts by running version-pinned linters directly on files that pass the provided test suites.
This design avoids model-generated lint alerts and makes the extraction protocol reproducible.
Specifically, we deploy clang-tidy (22.1.0) for C++, Pylint (4.0.5) for Python, and PMD (7.12.0) for Java.
The comprehensive sets of active rules and detailed configurations are provided in Appendix A.3 (Table 13 ) to support reproducibility.
blocks.zh:
LintEval通过直接在通过所提供的测试套件的文件上运行版本被绑定的linters来识别lint提醒.
这种设计避免了模型生成的林特警示,使取出协议可以再出.
具体来说,我们为C++部署crang-tidy(22.1.0),为Pylint(4.0.5)部署Python,为Java部署PMD(7.12.0).
附录A.3(表13)提供了一整套现行规则和详细配置,以支持可复制性。

blocks.en: 2.3 Benchmark Instance Construction
blocks.zh: 2.3 基准实例构建

blocks.en: Each benchmark instance assembles the source code and its extracted lint alerts into a standardized prompt (Figure 1 ) that instructs the model to reduce the provided lint alerts while satisfying functionality preservation. The full prompt is provided in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 每个基准实例将源代码及其提取的林特提示组合成一个标准化的快报(图1),指示模型在满足功能保存的同时减少提供的林特提示. 附录A.4提供了全部提示。

blocks.zh: 2.4 数据集特征和统计

blocks.en:
As summarized in Table 2 , LintEval comprises 13,061 samples spanning 3,999 unique problems across C++ (6,165), Python (4,221), and Java (2,675).
Average program length is 61.0 LOC with a density of 13.1 alerts per sample.
As illustrated in Figure 2 , the lint alert categories are dominated by Style (67.3%), while Error-prone, Performance, and Refactor domains collectively account for 31.6%.

blocks.en: 2.5 Taxonomy Normalization
blocks.zh: 2.5 分类学

blocks.en: Given the disparate output formats of different linters, we normalize all detected alerts into a unified taxonomy to facilitate cross-language evaluation. We categorize lint alerts into five dimensions: Error-prone, Performance, Refactor, Style, and Other. Table 2 presents the alert counts per category. The detailed cross-language mapping is provided in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en: For evaluation, two alerts are considered identical if they share the same rule identifier and sanitized text content. We explicitly exclude line numbers from this matching process to prevent interference from line shifts caused by code edits.
blocks.zh: 对于评价来说,如果两个提示共享相同的规则标识符和已消毒的文本内容,则被认为是相同的. 我们明确将行号排除在这个匹配过程之外,以防止由代码编辑导致的行向转移的干扰.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate two closed-source commercial models ( GPT-5.2 , GPT-5.4-mini ) and the following open-source models on the LintEval benchmark: DeepSeek-v3.2 , Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B/3B/7B/32B , and Llama-3.2-1B/3B . To broaden the scale and recency coverage, we additionally evaluate Qwen3-4B/8B , Qwen3.5-9B , and Qwen3.6-27B/35B-A3B under the same single-turn, zero-shot protocol without fine-tuning. The appendix also reports SFT robustness checks with DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct . Thus, the evaluation includes multiple small open-source models from 0.5B to 4B, alongside larger checkpoints, rather than relying on a single model scale. All models use the fixed greedy decoding configuration reported in Appendix A.5 and an identical prompt to ensure a standardized comparison. SFT variants are analyzed separately in Section 4.4 . We use Qwen2.5-Coder as the controlled SFT backbone to hold the backbone fixed across supervision formats.

SFT变体在第4.4节中单独分析. 我们使用Quen2.5-Coder作为受控的SFT主干线,将主干固定在监督格式之间.

blocks.en: We compare against two control references. Copy-Original returns the source code unchanged, establishing a zero-edit upper bound on functionality preservation. Rule-Based Baselines apply developer-standard tools: ruff --fix (Python), clang-tidy --fix (C++), and google-java-format (Java). 2 2 2 google-java-format targets only formatting alerts, so the Java rule-based baseline is conservative on non-formatting categories.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate newer Qwen checkpoints under the same single-turn, zero-shot protocol without fine-tuning. This comparison tests whether the main findings depend on the choice of open-source backbone and reports both functionality preservation and lint alert reduction; the results are shown in Table 6 .

blocks.en:
Linter-guided file refactoring exposes three behavioral regimes that no single model category dominates simultaneously (Table 3 ).
Excluding the no-op Copy-Original control, rule-based baselines achieve the highest functionality preservation ( 76.3 % 76.3\% Pass@1) but resolve only 25.9 % 25.9\% of lint alerts, suggesting that fixed rule coverage leaves many lint alerts unresolved under this protocol.
Additional-analyzer and tool-coverage audits confirm that results depend partly on analyzer–repair-tool coverage; full diagnostics are reported in Appendix A.1 .
Closed-source commercial models achieve the highest lint alert reduction (e.g., GPT-5.4-mini at 90.4 % 90.4\% Reduction@P), but their Pass@1 remains 67.1 % 67.1\% – 68.3 % 68.3\% , indicating a clear trade-off with functionality preservation.
Several open-source models show low or negative lint alert reduction (as low as − 1.2 % -1.2\% for Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B ), especially when edits introduce more new alerts than they resolve.
Across rule-based baselines, closed-source commercial models, and open-source models, no method jointly optimizes all four dimensions; these results suggest that the trade-off is not solely an artifact of any single method, but a recurring constraint of linter-guided file refactoring.
blocks.zh:
互导文件重构显示三种行为制度,没有单一模式类别同时主导(表3).
除"不复制-原件"控制外,基于规则的基线实现了最高功能保存(76.3% 76.3+% Pass@1),但只解决了25.9% 25.9+%的lint提醒,说明固定规则覆盖度留下了许多在协议下未解决的lint提醒.
补充分析员和工具覆盖审计证实,结果部分取决于分析员-修复工具的覆盖;完整的诊断结果在附录A.1中报告。
闭源商业模型实现最高的Lint警示降低(如:GPT-5.4-mini at 90.4% 90.4++++@P),但其Pass@1仍为67.1% 67.1%–68.3% 68.3+++),表明与功能保存有明确的取舍.
多个开源模型显示低或负的Lint警示减少(Quen2.5-Coder-0.5B的低至-1.2%-1.2\%),特别是当编辑引入比它们解决的更多新警示时.
在所有基于规则的基线、封闭源码的商业模型和开源模型中,没有一种方法能共同优化所有四个维度;这些结果表明,取舍不仅仅是任何单一方法的产物,而是一种反复出现的对互导文件重构的限制。

blocks.en:
Although rule-based baselines make the largest edits ( Δ \Delta Line@P = 71.4 =71.4 ) for only moderate alert reduction, closed-source commercial models achieve substantially higher Reduction@P with far lower amortized cost (e.g., GPT-5.4-mini at 14.2 14.2 LinePerFix@P).
Open-source models show the lowest amortized cost ( Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B at 9.5 9.5 LinePerFix@P); however, LinePerFix@P is meaningful only when paired with positive Reduction@P.
Thus, edit minimality is meaningful only as a constrained efficiency measure, not as an independent ranking signal.
Supplementary structural diagnostics likewise indicate that passing revisions are generally localized (Appendix A.1 ).

虽然基于规则的基线使编辑量最大(\\\Delta Line@P=71.4=71.4),但闭源商业模型实现大幅度的降低@ P分期摊还成本要低得多(例如,GPT-5.4-mini在14.2 14.2 LinePerFix@P).

因此,编辑最小化只是作为受限制的效率措施,而不是作为独立的排名信号才有意义.
补充结构诊断也表明,通过的订正一般是局部的(附录A.1)。

blocks.en:
For diagnostic analysis only, we analogously compute @F metrics over failed instances D ∖ S pass D\setminus S_{\text{pass}} ; these metrics are not used as primary quality metrics.
Data in Table 4 illustrates distinct behavioral patterns during refactoring failures.
For closed-source models, both lint alert reduction and average edit volume remain similar across passed and failed runs, showing smaller divergence than open-source models.
Conversely, several open-source models exhibit a stark asymmetric shift, where lint alert reduction drops from positive values to strongly negative values during failed runs (e.g., Qwen2.5-Coder-7B dropping from 24.7 % 24.7\% to − 88.2 % -88.2\% ), correlating with a reduction in average edit volume.
This pattern indicates that on failed instances, open-source models’ failures are not driven by excessive rewriting, but by weak target selection: fewer edits still introduce more new alerts than they remove, while also failing functionality preservation.
These two failure modes mark the task frontier: closed-source commercial models face a functionality preservation bottleneck once lint alert reduction is largely achieved, whereas open-source models must first learn safe, targeted edits.
A complementary failure-type breakdown confirms that build success is not a reliable proxy for functionality preservation (Table 10 ).

反之,若干开源模型呈现出明显的不对称变化,在运行失败期间,灵敏度降低从正值降至强烈负值(例如:Quen2.5-Coder-7B从24.7% 24.7%下降到-88.2% -88.2 %),与平均编辑量减少有关.

这两种失败模式标志着任务前沿:一旦基本实现Lint警戒减少,闭源商业模式就面临功能保护瓶颈,而开源模式必须首先学习安全、有针对性的编辑。

blocks.en: 4.3 Influencing Factors
blocks.zh: 4.3 影响因素

blocks.en:
Table 5 reveals a pronounced cross-lingual performance gradient across all paradigms.
C++ emerges as the most stable domain, where even open-source models consistently achieve positive lint alert reduction; this pattern may reflect differences in linter rule sets, alert category distribution, and dataset composition rather than language typing discipline alone.
Conversely, Python and Java present higher optimization barriers: while closed-source commercial models remain above 77 % 77\% Reduction@P, some open-source models exhibit negative Reduction@P.
Notably, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B reaches its lowest Reduction@P on Python ( 19.0 % 19.0\% ) and remains low on Java ( 21.6 % 21.6\% ), both far below its C++ result ( 27.6 % 27.6\% ).
One plausible explanation is that many C++ alerts correspond to localized transformation patterns, whereas Python and Java alerts more often involve naming, convention, or structure-level changes that require broader surrounding context.

表5显示在所有范式中明显的跨语言业绩梯度。
C++作为最稳定的域出现,即使开源模型也始终实现正升降警戒;这种模式可能反映在linter规则集,提醒类分布,以及数据集构成上的差异,而不只是语言打字纪律.
反之,Python和Java呈现出更高的优化屏障:虽然闭源商业模型仍然高于77 % 77.% += 减少@P,但一些开源模型呈现出负减少@P.
值得注意的是,Quen2.5-Coder-7B在Python(19.0% 19.0\%)上达到了最低的P还原率,在Java(21.6% 21.6\%)上仍然很低,两者都远低于其C++结果(27.6% 27.6\% ).
一个可信的解释是,许多C++警报与局部变换模式相对应,而Python和Java警报更经常涉及命名,会场,或结构层面的变化,需要更广泛的周边环境.

blocks.en:
Alert category difficulty varies sharply across model scales, with Error-prone and Style alerts posing the greatest challenge (Figure 3 ).
GPT-5.4-mini achieves above 84 % 84\% Reduction@P on Error-prone and above 90 % 90\% on Performance and Style categories; DeepSeek-v3.2 shows a different profile, excelling on Performance ( 77.6 % 77.6\% ) and Refactor ( 53.6 % 53.6\% ) but dropping to 46.1 % 46.1\% on Error-prone.
Smaller open-source models are less reliable overall: the 0.5B model reaches only − 1.2 % -1.2\% Reduction@P, while the 7B model reaches 24.7 % 24.7\% and preserves substantially more functionality. Nevertheless, even the 7B model remains sensitive to language and category, with only 19.0 % 19.0\% Reduction@P on Python and 21.6 % 21.6\% on Java (additional size- and category-specific results are reported in Appendix A.7 , Table 18 ).
The three categories appear to stress different capabilities: Performance alerts map to localized idioms applicable with little context, whereas Error-prone alerts require semantic judgment that stresses functionality preservation, and Style alerts—the most numerous ( 67.3 % 67.3\% )—are fine-grained, so partial rewrites readily leave residual or inconsistent violations.
Performing well on LintEval thus requires both high-volume cleanup and semantically sensitive modification.
At the instance level, only 36.6% of programs are Style-only; 43.6% are mixed and 3.2% contain potentially behavior-relevant rules only, so at least 46.8% contain a potentially behavior-relevant rule (Appendix A.1 ). At the rule level, Style-only rules account for 78.9% of alerts.

GPT-5.4-mini的成绩高于84 % 84-% @P关于易出错的成绩和样式类别为90-%;DeepSeek-v3.2的成绩不同,表现优异(77.6% 77.6-%)和Refactor(53.6% 53.6-%),但易出错的成绩降至46.1% 46.1-%。

这三类似乎强调不同的能力: 性能警示图可以映射到很少上下文适用的地方性偶数,而容易出错的警示则需要强调功能保存的语义判断,而Style警示(数量最多(67.3%为67.3))是精细的,因此部分重写很容易留下剩余或不一致的违反.
因此,在LintEval上表现良好既需要大量清理,也需要敏锐地修改。

blocks.en:
Higher alert density amplifies difficulty. For GPT-5.4-mini , Pass@1 drops from 82.1 % 82.1\% on single-alert files to 63.9 % 63.9\% on files with more than 10 10 alerts, while Reduction@P rises from 62.5 % 62.5\% to 92.1 % 92.1\% . Capable models thus resolve clustered alerts in bulk, but the resulting broader modification tendency contributes to the Pass@1 decline of 18.2 18.2 percentage points.
This density effect parallels the refactoring-oriented SFT format (Section 4.4 ): in both, more input lint alerts are associated with a broader edit scope, suggesting the pressure toward broader file-level rewriting arises partly from the alert signal itself.
Full scaling curves are provided in Appendix A.8 (Table 20 ).

To isolate the contribution of explicit lint alerts, we re-run all models with an alert-free prompt that retains the refactoring instruction but omits the lint alert list.
Removing alerts improves Pass@1 by 4.9 4.9 – 27.1 27.1 percentage points, but weakens lint alert reduction for models that benefit from alert conditioning and increases LinePerFix@P for all models, with the largest raw increase on Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B ( 9.5 9.5 to 74.4 74.4 ; Table 7 ).
This pattern suggests that, without lint alerts, models either make conservative edits that preserve functionality but fix few reported violations, or perform untargeted rewrites with poor edit efficiency.
Explicit lint alerts therefore serve as localization signals and intervention signals: they tell models where to edit and what to optimize, but they also increase pressure to modify code that already satisfies functionality preservation.
In a matched Qwen2.5-Coder-7B comparison, combining developer instructions with lint alerts preserves the lint-only Pass@1 ( 90.0 % 90.0\% ) and nearly preserves Reduction@P ( 39.0 % 39.0\% vs. 39.9 % 39.9\% ), while lowering New@P from 10.6 % 10.6\% to 7.1 % 7.1\% ; instructions alone reach higher Pass@1 ( 95.0 % 95.0\% ) but lower Reduction@P ( 25.0 % 25.0\% ) (Appendix A.1 ). This synthetic-instruction evaluation set is separate from the multi-round set, so their absolute values are not directly comparable.

删除提醒可以使 Pass@1 提高 4.9 4.9 – 27.1 27.1 个百分点,但会削弱对受益于提醒调制的模型的提示降低,并增加 LinePerFix@ 所有型号的P型,以Quen2.5-Coder-0.5B型(9.5 9.5至74.4 74.4;表7)为最大生增.
这种模式表明,如果不发出提示,模型要么进行保守的编辑,保留功能,但纠正很少报告的违规行为,要么进行不目标重写,编辑效率低下.
因此,明确的Lint提示作为本地化信号和干预信号:它们告诉模型在哪里编辑和如何优化,但也增加了修改已经满足功能保存的压力.

blocks.en: 4.4 Impact of Instruction Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.4 教学的影响

blocks.en: We construct the fine-tuning corpus from 1,196 problem instances outside LintEval to avoid problem-level contamination. For each instance we collect the problem statement Q Q , the original implementation A A , its lint alerts L L , and a refined implementation A ′ A^{\prime} distilled from GPT-5.2 . A 10 % 10\% stratified sample is manually audited to confirm that distilled revisions remove the intended alerts while preserving behavior; full corpus statistics are provided in Appendix A.9 (Table 23 ). We fine-tune the Qwen2.5-Coder family with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) ( r = 16 r{=}16 , α = 32 \alpha{=}32 , learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , effective batch size 8 8 , 3 3 epochs) under three formulations: A+L → \to A ′ (refactoring-oriented: original code plus alerts → \to refined code), Q → \to A (vanilla generation: problem → \to original code), and Q → \to A ′ (quality-purified generation: problem → \to refined code).
blocks.zh: 我们从LintEval以外的1,196起问题中构建出微调装置,以避免问题层面的污染。 每一次我们收集问题说明Q, 最初的执行AA, 其提示L, 对10%的分层抽样进行了人工审计,以确认提炼过的修改在保留行为的同时消除了预期的警示;附录A.9提供了完整的整体统计数据(表23)。 我们用LORA(Hu等,2022年)对Quen2.5-Coder家族进行微调(r = 16 r{=}16, α = 32 alpha{=}32,学习率2×10 − 5 2\times 10^{5},有效批量尺寸为8个8个,3个3个时代)在三种配方下: A+L → \to A (重塑:正版代码加警示 → \to精制代码),Q → A (vanilla generation: problem → \ to 原版代码),和Q → A (正版代码: problem → \ to 精制代码).

blocks.en:
A+L → \to A ′ provides the closest match to linter-guided file refactoring because the model observes both the original file and its lint alerts during training.
This alignment yields the strongest lint alert reduction, with the 3B model improving from 9.5 % 9.5\% to 85.0 % 85.0\% Reduction@P.
However, the same format also produces the largest edit scope across all scales, suggesting that it learns to resolve lint alerts through broader file-level rewrites rather than minimal local changes.
This helps explain why A+L → \to A ′ improves new alert avoidance relative to Base but still has higher New@P and lower Pass@1 than Q → \to A .
Refactoring-oriented supervision is therefore effective for lint alert reduction, but it does not by itself guarantee functionality preservation or edit minimality.
This scope dependence is scale-sensitive: A+L → \to A ′ raises Pass@1 at 3B and 7B but lowers it at 0.5B ( 48.8 % 48.8\% → \to 37.8 % 37.8\% ), suggesting the format’s multi-source conditioning becomes reliable only above a minimum model capacity.
The direction of the Reduction@P effect is stable across language and size: A+L → \to A ′ exceeds Base in all nine language-size cells, with gains of + 23.0 +23.0 to + 89.6 +89.6 points, while Pass@1 changes are mixed, ranging from − 22.5 -22.5 to + 23.6 +23.6 points (Table 11 ). Additional checks extend the comparison beyond one training regime: full-parameter SFT on Qwen2.5-Coder-3B improves A+L → \to A ′ from 59.0% to 63.7% Pass@1 and from 84.0% to 85.8% Reduction@P. On DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct, A+L → \to A ′ improves over Base from 25.3% to 61.2% Pass@1 and from 19.0% to 79.0% Reduction@P, and is the only tested format above Base on both metrics (Table 12 ).

blocks.en:
Q → \to A optimizes a different behavior: generating an original correct solution from the problem statement rather than modifying a given file under lint alerts.
This format yields the strongest functionality preservation among the fine-tuned variants, reaching 68.3 % 68.3\% Pass@1 on 7B , and consistently gives the lowest New@P.
The cost is limited lint alert reduction: for 7B , Reduction@P remains 15.8 % 15.8\% , below the Base result of 24.7 % 24.7\% .
This pattern suggests that generation-oriented supervision encourages conservative edits and new alert avoidance, but does not teach models to use lint alerts as actionable refactoring targets.

blocks.en:
Q → \to A ′ exposes models to refined implementations, but it still omits the original file and its lint alerts from the training input.
As a result, it can transfer a code-quality prior without learning the conditional editing behavior required by linter-guided file refactoring.
This explains its mixed behavior: on 7B , it improves Reduction@P to 47.9 % 47.9\% while keeping Pass@1 close to Q → \to A ; on 3B , however, New@P rises to 22.2 % 22.2\% , indicating unstable new alert avoidance.
Quality-purified generation is therefore useful only when the model can translate the cleaner target distribution into controlled file-level edits.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Automated program repair benchmarks evaluate debugging proficiency across standalone snippets or complex repository-level environments, using real-world faults such as Defects4J ( Just et al., 2014 ) , debugging tasks in DebugBench ( Tian et al., 2024 ) , repository-level issues in SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , and learned detect-localize-repair pipelines such as CodeT5 ( Bui et al., 2022 ) . Interactive code-generation and execution-feedback methods, including Reflexion, InterCode, and FeedbackEval ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Dai et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , study related feedback-driven behavior but are not specifically bug-repair benchmarks.
These works primarily target debugging or code generation, rather than improving code quality under strict functionality preservation, which motivates a dedicated benchmark.
blocks.zh:
自动程序修补基准通过独立片段或复杂的寄存层环境评价调试熟练程度,使用Defects4J等现实世界断层 (Just等,2014年),调试德布克奔克的任务(Tian等,2024年),SWE-bench的寄存层问题(Jimenez等,2024年),并学习了CodeT5等探测-本地化-修理管(Bui等,2022年). 互动代码生成与执行反馈方法,包括Reflexion,InterCode,和RegressEval(Shinn等,2023;Yang等,2023;Dai等,2025;Wang等,2023),研究相关的反馈驱动行为,但并非特指的bug-reading基准.
这些作品主要针对调试或代码生成,而不是在严格的功能保存下提高代码质量,这激发了专用的基准.

blocks.en:
Existing refactoring benchmarks target programmatic modifications but differ significantly in tool guidance and evaluation scope.
RefactorBench ( Gautam et al., 2025 ) measures instruction-driven refactoring under free-form text requests without structured tool feedback.
Concurrently, MetaLint ( Naik et al., 2025 ) evaluates model capabilities in detecting and localizing best-practice violations from natural language specifications, while LintLLM ( Fang et al., 2025 ) targets hardware defect identification in Verilog RTL code.
However, these benchmarks remain domain-specific and focus on passive alert detection and localization rather than active transformation execution under structured lint alerts.
blocks.zh:
现行重构基准的目标是方案修改,但在工具指导和评价范围方面差异很大。
Refactor Bench(Gautam等,2025年)在自由格式文本请求下测量指令驱动重构,没有结构化工具反馈.
同时,MetaLint(Naik等,2025年)评价了从自然语言规范中发现并本地化最佳做法违规行为的模型能力,而LintLLLM(Fang等,2025年)的目标是Verilog RTL代码中的硬件缺陷识别.
然而,这些基准仍然是针对域的,侧重于被动警报检测和本地化,而不是在结构化提示下进行主动转换执行.

blocks.en: Linters and static analyzers are widely used to surface code-quality issues and support maintenance workflows ( Beller et al., 2016 ; Christakis and Bird, 2016 ; Tómasdóttir et al., 2020 ; Zampetti et al., 2017 ; Kószó et al., 2025 ) . Automated techniques have been developed to address such issues, including template- and program-transformation-based fixes ( Marcilio et al., 2020 ) , while more recent work uses LLMs together with static-analysis or code-quality feedback ( Wadhwa et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Blyth et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) . These paradigms lack a standardized benchmark that jointly evaluates functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality—the gap LintEval fills.
blocks.zh: 林特斯和静态分析器被广泛用于表面代码质量问题和支持维护工作流程(Beller等,2016;Christakis and Bird,2016;Tómasdóttir等,2020;Zampetti等,2017;Kószó等,2025). 为解决这类问题,已经开发出自动化技术,包括基于模板和以程序转换为基础的修正(Marcilio等,2020年),而最近的工作则使用LLMs以及静态分析或编码质量反馈(Wadhwa等,2024年;Li等,2024年;Li等,2025年;Blyth等,2025年;Yao等,2025年)。 这些范式缺乏一个标准化的基准,无法共同评价功能保存、减少提示、新的提醒避让和编辑最小度——LintEval的漏洞填补。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce LintEval , a large-scale, multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring on programs with correct initial functionality. Under high-coverage test oracles, no method dominates: rule-based baselines preserve functionality but reduce few lint alerts, whereas closed-source commercial models reduce more lint alerts at the cost of functionality preservation, and open-source models show cross-language and alert-category weaknesses partly mitigated by refactoring-oriented fine-tuning. Jointly optimizing these four dimensions remains an open challenge for automated code maintenance.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了 LintEval, 一个大型的,多语言的基准,用于在具有正确初始功能的程序上重构l-guided文件. 在高覆盖测试甲骨文下,没有方法主导:基于规则的基线保留了功能,但减少了很少的林特提示;而闭源商业模型则以功能保存为代价来减少更多的林特提示;开源模型显示跨语言和警戒类弱点,部分通过重设导向的微调来缓解. 联合优化这四个维度仍然是自动化代码维护的一个公开挑战。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our benchmark primarily evaluates linter-guided file refactoring within an explicitly controlled environment using algorithmic tasks from CodeContests+ .
While this setup provides high-coverage test oracles to help isolate core capabilities, it omits production-level architectural complexities such as cross-file dependencies or multi-turn iterative developer workflows.
Additionally, our evaluation measures dynamic functionality preservation via Pass@1 metrics rather than formal semantic equivalence or structural maintainability metrics.
Finally, our supervised fine-tuning analysis is bounded in scale and optimized primarily for the Qwen2.5-Coder architecture, which may introduce architectural biases across specific lint alert categories and open-source models.
blocks.zh:
我们的基准主要使用 CodeContests + 的算法任务,在明确控制的环境中评价介导文件重构。
虽然这种设置提供了高覆盖测试甲骨文来帮助隔离核心能力,但它省略了生产层面的建筑复杂性,如交叉文件依赖性或多回合迭代开发者工作流程等.
此外,我们的评价通过Pass@1度量衡量动态功能保全,而不是正式语义等同或结构可维护度量。
最后,我们监督的微调分析是规模化的,并主要为Quen2.5-Coder建筑进行优化,这可能会在具体的林特警戒类别和开源模型中引入建筑偏差。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
This work follows the ACL Ethics Policy.
We utilize the publicly available CodeContests+ dataset under its original open-source licensing, ensuring that no personal, private, or sensitive user data is involved in our benchmark construction.
We used generative AI writing assistance only for language polishing and grammatical refinement; all experimental design, analysis, and claims were produced and verified by the authors.

我们只为语言抛光和语法改进而使用基因AI书写协助;所有实验设计,分析和主张都由作者制作和核实.

blocks.en: A.1 Additional Diagnostic Results
blocks.zh: A.1 其他诊断结果

blocks.en: These diagnostics answer four questions raised during review: whether iterative feedback changes the functionality–reduction trade-off, whether the findings persist for newer backbones, what causes functional failures, and whether the SFT effect transfers across languages and training settings. We report full tables only when row-level comparisons matter; compact audits are summarized in prose below.
blocks.zh: 这些诊断解答了审查期间提出的四个问题:迭接反馈是否改变了功能-减少取舍,结论是否对较新的骨干根基继续存在,哪些导致功能故障,以及SFT效应是否跨语言和培训环境转移。 只有在行级比较事项上,我们才报告完整的表格;以下文总结了契约审计。

blocks.en: Tables 9–12 present four complementary diagnostic analyses with different units and comparison scopes. The iterative-feedback table compares two rounds of the same procedure, the failure table reports percentages within non-passing revisions, and the two SFT tables report either differences from Base or absolute performance under a training setting. Consequently, values should be compared within each table rather than combined across tables. In particular, conditional Reduction@P always describes the subset that passes functionality tests in the corresponding round or setting; it is not an unconditional estimate over all attempted revisions.
blocks.zh: 表9-12列出了四个辅助诊断分析,其单位和比较范围各不相同。 迭接式反馈表比较了两轮相同的程序,故障表报告非通过订正的百分比,两个SFT表报告与Base的差异,或在培训环境下报告绝对业绩。 因此,应当在每个表格中比较数值,而不是将各种表格综合起来。 特别是有条件减少@ P总是描述在相应的回合或设置中通过功能测试的子集;它并不是对所有尝试修改的无条件估计.

blocks.en: Three rounds of a fixed mini-swe-agent loop increase conditional Reduction@P for all three tested models, but Pass@1 decreases slightly (Table 9 ). Thus, repeated linter feedback helps remove alerts without resolving the functionality trade-off. The newer-Qwen comparison in the main paper (Table 6 ) reaches the same conclusion from a different direction: Qwen3-8B has the highest Reduction@P but the lowest Pass@1, while Qwen3.6-35B-A3B has the highest Pass@1 but lower Reduction@P. No tested checkpoint dominates both dimensions.

blocks.en: The magnitude of the multi-round gain is also model-dependent. DeepSeek-v3.2 obtains the largest Reduction@P increase (+10.0 points), closely followed by GPT-5.4-mini (+9.0), whereas Qwen2.5-Coder-7B improves by only 1.9 points. All three incur a Pass@1 loss, ranging from 1.2 to 3.8 points. This directional consistency suggests that another round primarily creates additional opportunities to edit remaining alerts; it does not act as a general correction mechanism for behavioral regressions. Since the passing subset can change between rounds, these differences characterize the observed trajectory of the fixed loop and should not be interpreted as a causal gain on an identical set of successful outputs.
blocks.zh: 多回合收益的规模也取决于模式。 DeepSeek-v3.2获得最大的减分@P增分(+10.0分),紧接其后的是GPT-5.4-mini(+9.0分),而Quen2.5-Coder-7B则只提高1.9分. 这三个项目都出现出入证@1损失,从1.2分到3.8分不等。 这种方向上的一致性表明,另一回合主要为编辑所剩的警报创造了更多机会;它不作为行为回归的一般纠正机制. 由于经过的子集可以在相轮之间发生变化,这些差异是所观察到的固定循环轨迹的特点,不应被解释为一组相同成功产出的因果收益.

blocks.en: Wrong answers dominate non-passing revisions across model families (Table 10 ); only 15.7%–22.0% of wrong-answer cases pass at least 90% of tests, so successful compilation is not a reliable proxy for functionality. The rule-based coverage audit provides a separate explanation for its limited alert reduction: the selected tool/analyzer pairings fix 77.0% of C++ alerts, 36.8% of Python alerts, and 5.2% of Java alerts, retaining 23.0%, 63.2%, and 94.8%, respectively. These shares use all original alerts and are not an arithmetic decomposition of conditional Reduction@P.

blocks.en: The balance among non-semantic failures varies by model. Build failures account for 10.5% of GPT-5.4-mini failures but 40.8% for Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B ; runtime errors likewise rise from 5.3% to 13.2% for the tested models with the highest observed rate. Nevertheless, wrong answers remain the plurality or majority in every row. This distinction matters operationally: syntax repair, compilation feedback, or sandbox retries can address build and runtime failures, but they cannot establish semantic equivalence for revisions that execute and still return incorrect results. The failure table therefore motivates retaining execution-based functionality tests as the primary gate rather than replacing them with build success.
blocks.zh: 非语义故障之间的平衡因模型而异. 建造故障占GPT-5.4-mini故障的10.5%,而Quen2.5-Coder-0.5B故障占40.8%;在观测率最高的测试模型中,运行时间出错也从5.3%上升到13.2%。 然而,错误的答案仍然是每一行的多元性或多数。 这种区分在操作上很重要:语法修补,编译反馈,或沙盒重试可以解决构建和运行时的故障,但它们不能为执行和仍然返回不正确结果的修订建立语义等同. 因此,失败表促使保留以执行为基础的功能测试作为主门,而不是取而代之的是建设成功。

blocks.en: At the instance level, 36.6% of programs contain Style-only rules, 43.6% mix Style with potentially behavior-relevant rules, 3.2% contain only potentially behavior-relevant rules, and 16.7% are unclear. At the rule level, the corresponding shares are 78.9%, 17.9%, and 3.3% (unclear). These labels characterize rule categories, not semantic-equivalence outcomes. A matched additional-analyzer audit finds files flagged only by Cppcheck, Ruff analysis mode, and Checkstyle in 16.0%, 32.0%, and 49.0% of C++, Python, and Java cases, respectively; this establishes analyzer dependence but does not imply transfer of model rankings.
blocks.zh: 在实例层面,36.6%的程序包含Style-Only规则,43.6%将Style与潜在行为相关规则相混合,3.2%只包含潜在行为相关规则,16.7%不明确. 在规则层面,相应的份额为78.9%、17.9%和3.3%(不明确)。 这些标签是规则类别的特点,而不是语义等同的结果. 一个匹配的附加分析器审计发现的文件仅被Cppcheck,Ruff分析模式所标注,以及C++,Python和Java案例的16.0%,32.0%和49.0%所标注的Ccheckstyle;这确立了分析者的依赖性,但并不意味着模型排名的转移.

blocks.en: Table 13: Language-specific linter configurations and runtime environments.
blocks.zh: 表13:语言特有linter配置和运行时环境.

blocks.en: Table 14: Cross-language taxonomy of lint alert categories in LintEval. Counts show the number of alerts in each diagnostic category. Representative rule families illustrate how each category maps to language-specific linter conventions.
blocks.zh: 表14: LintEval中lint警示类的跨语言分类. 计数显示每个诊断类别中的警报次数. 代表性的规则家庭说明每个类别如何映射特定语言的互通公约。

blocks.en: Refactoring-oriented A+L → \to A ′ supervision improves Reduction@P over Base in all nine language–size cells, while Pass@1 changes are mixed (Table 11 ). The effect also survives full-parameter Qwen2.5-Coder-3B training and a DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B backbone (Table 12 ). In a matched Qwen2.5-Coder-7B input audit, lint alerts achieve 90.0% Pass@1, 39.9% Reduction@P, and 10.6% New@P; developer instructions alone yield 95.0%, 25.0%, and 6.0%; combining both yields 90.0%, 39.0%, and 7.1%. The combined input therefore retains nearly all alert reduction while introducing fewer new alerts.
blocks.zh: 重构面向 A+L →\去 `监督有助于减少' 所有9个语言大小单元格中的 P over Base,而 Pass@ 1 变化是混合的(表11). 该效应还活过全参数的Quen2.5-Coder-3B训练并有一个DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B骨干(表12. 在匹配的 Quen2.5- Coder-7B 输入审核中, 提示实现 90.0% Pass@1, 39.9% P 和 10.6% New@P; 开发者指令单是 95.0%, 25.0% 和 6.0%; 两者结合 90.0%, 39.0% 和 7.1% 。 因此,综合投入保留了几乎所有的戒备减少,同时采用了较少的新警报。

blocks.en: The language–size table separates robustness of the optimization target from robustness of functionality preservation. Reduction@P gains are positive in every cell, from +23.0 points for 7B Java to +89.6 points for 0.5B C++, showing that the supervision format consistently teaches alert removal. Pass@1, however, improves mainly on Python at 3B and 7B and on Java at 3B, while decreasing in the remaining cells. Full-parameter training does not reverse this pattern: it modestly improves both reported metrics over the matched 3B LoRA setting, but it does not by itself demonstrate that broader updates eliminate the trade-off.
blocks.zh: 语言-大小表将优化目标的稳健性与功能保存的稳健性区分开来. 减少@ P增益在每一个单元格中都是正的,从7B Java的+23.0分到0.5B C++的+89.6分,表明监督格式一贯教戒去除. 然而,Pass@1主要改进了Python在3B和7B以及Java在3B上的功能,而其余的细胞则在不断减少. 全参数培训并没有扭转这种模式:它比对应的3B LORA设置略微改进了两个报告的指标,但它本身并不表明更广泛的更新消除了取舍。

blocks.en: The DeepSeek-Coder results provide a stronger transfer check because both the backbone and model size change. A+L → \to A ′ raises Pass@1 from 25.3% to 61.2% and Reduction@P from 19.0% to 79.0%, whereas the two generation-oriented formats do not improve both metrics over Base. Together, these diagnostics support a bounded conclusion: refactoring-oriented supervision transfers as an alert-reduction signal across the tested languages, scales, training regimes, and backbones, but its functionality effect remains contingent on model capacity and setting.
blocks.zh: DeepSeek-Coder结果提供了更强的传输检查,因为主干和模型大小都发生了变化. A+L →\ to A ' 将Pass@1从25.3%提高到61.2%,并减少@P从19.0%提高到79.0%,而两种面向一代的格式并没有改进两种衡量标准。 这些诊断一起支持一个有限度的结论:重构面向监督的转移,作为跨越所测试语言、尺度、培训制度和主干线的减少警戒信号,但其功能效果仍取决于模型能力和设置。

blocks.en: Across the four tables, additional computation and targeted supervision both increase alert reduction, yet only the refactoring-oriented transfer check improves functionality and reduction together. Iteration alone slightly lowers Pass@1, and failure decomposition shows that many regressions are semantic rather than merely syntactic. The diagnostics therefore reinforce the main evaluation design: alert reduction must remain conditioned on independently verified functionality, and improvements should be reported jointly rather than collapsed into a single cleanup score.
blocks.zh: 在所有四个表格中,额外的计算和定向监督都提高了警戒率,但只有面向重构的转移检查才能共同改进功能并减少。 仅迭代就略低了Pass@1,而故障分解表明许多回归是语义性的,而不只是合成. 因此,诊断加强了主要评价设计:降低警觉必须始终以独立核实的功能为条件,改进应联合报告,而不是崩溃为单一的清理分数。

blocks.en: A.2 Cross-Language Taxonomy
blocks.zh: A.2 跨语言分类学

blocks.en: Table 14 presents the cross-language taxonomy of lint alert categories used in LintEval. The taxonomy groups heterogeneous linter outputs from clang-tidy, Pylint, and PMD into five unified categories: Error-prone, Performance, Refactor, Style, and Other. This normalization enables aggregate cross-language analysis while preserving the original rule identifiers for per-rule inspection.
blocks.zh: 表14列出LintEval中使用的lint警示类的跨语言分类. 分类法将来自clang-tidy、Pylint和PMD的异质互通输出分为五个统一类别:易出错、性能、重构、样式等。 这种正常化使得能够进行综合的跨语言分析,同时保留原来的规则识别符,用于每条规则检查.

blocks.en: Style alerts dominate the dataset (67.3%), while Error-prone, Performance, and Refactor alerts collectively account for 31.6%, making consistent file-wide editing a central challenge. Our taxonomy groups rules by semantic concern rather than rule-name similarity; the released data retains each source analyzer and rule identifier so the aggregate categories remain auditable and can be regrouped for analyzer-specific analysis.
blocks.zh: 样式提示主导了数据集(67.3%),而易出错,性能,和Refactor提醒共同占了31.6%,使得一致的全文件编辑成为中心挑战. 我们的分类学分组通过语义关切而不是规则名称的相似性来进行规则;发布的数据保留了每个源分析器和规则标识符,因此汇总分类仍然可以审计,可以重新组合用于分析器特定分析.

blocks.en: Table 15: Decoding configurations for all evaluated models. All models use greedy decoding. Local models are served via vLLM.
blocks.zh: 表15 所有被评价模型的解码配置. 所有模型都使用贪婪的解码. 本地模型通过vLLM服务.

blocks.en: A.3 Execution Environment
blocks.zh: A.3 执行环境

blocks.en: Table 13 reports the linter versions and runtime configurations used for lint alert extraction. Reproducibility of the linting stage is critical because linter diagnostics can vary across versions, enabled rule sets, and runtime environments. For example, clang-tidy 22.1.0 introduces several new modernize-* checks compared to earlier versions, and PMD 7.12.0 reorganizes rule categories differently from PMD 6.x.
blocks.zh: 表13汇报了用于lint提示提取的linter版本和运行时配置. 闪烁阶段的可复制性至关重要,因为linter诊断可以因版本不同而有差异,允许的规则集,以及运行时的环境. 例如:cirg-tidy 22.1.0 与之前的版本相比,引入了几种新的现代化-*检查,而PMD 7.1.20. 重整规则类别与PMD 6.x不同.

blocks.en: Across all three languages, each execution is subject to a 10-second timeout and a 1GB memory limit to prevent runaway analysis on pathological inputs. The compilers and runtime versions (g++ 13.3.0, Python 3.12.10, OpenJDK 21.0.10) are pinned to ensure that functionality tests execute consistently across runs.
blocks.zh: 在所有三种语言中,每次执行都要有10秒的超时和1GB的内存限制,以防止对病理输入进行跑出分析. 编译器和运行时间版本(g++ 13.3.0,Python 3.12.10,OpenJDK 21.0.10)被固定,以确保功能测试一致地执行跨运行.

blocks.en: These resource limits apply uniformly across models and languages; they are part of the evaluation protocol rather than model-specific tuning. Pinning both analyzer and execution environments is necessary because the benchmark measures two linked outcomes: alerts are counted under the analyzer configuration, while functionality is decided by language-specific execution. Changing either side can alter the passing subset and therefore every conditional @P metric. Reproduction should consequently treat the versions, enabled checks, timeout, and memory cap as a single configuration rather than substituting tools independently.
blocks.zh: 这些资源限制在模型和语言之间统一适用;它们是评价协议的一部分,而不是针对模型的调整。 固定分析器和执行环境是必要的,因为基准度量两个相联的结果:在分析器配置下计算出提醒,而功能则由语言特定执行决定. 改变任何一方都可以改变所经过的子集,从而改变每个条件的@P 度量. 因此,复制应把版本、允许检查、超时和内存封顶作为单一配置处理,而不是独立替换工具。

blocks.en: A.4 Prompt Template
blocks.zh: A.4 快速模板

blocks.en: The full prompt template used for evaluation is shown below. The prompt is designed to mirror realistic tool-feedback workflows where developers receive linter output and must revise code accordingly.
blocks.zh: 用于评价的完整即时模板如下。 提示被设计成反映现实的工具反馈工作流程,其中开发者接收linter输出,必须相应修改代码.

blocks.en: The prompt provides five key elements: (1) the programming language to set context, (2) the original accepted code as the starting point, (3) the full list of lint alerts with rule IDs, file paths, and line numbers as the modification signal, (4) explicit requirements for functionality preservation, maximal lint reduction, minimal new-alert introduction, and minimal editing, and (5) a code-block-only output constraint to facilitate automated extraction.
blocks.zh: 即时提示提供了五个关键要素:(1)设置上下文的编程语言;(2)原始被接受的代码作为起点;(3)以规则ID,文件路径,行号作为修改信号的Lint提醒的完整列表;(4)对功能保存,最大限度的lint还原,最小的新警示引入,最小的编辑;以及(5)一个只有代码块的输出限制,以方便自动化取出.

blocks.en: A.5 Model Decoding Configuration
blocks.zh: A.5 模型解码配置

blocks.en: Table 15 lists the decoding parameters for all evaluated models. All models use greedy decoding (temperature = 0.0 =0.0 ) with the same prompt template. This standardized setup ensures that performance differences are attributable to model behavior rather than sampling variation or prompt engineering.
blocks.zh: 表15列出了所有被评价模型的解码参数. 所有模型都使用同一种即时模板的贪婪解码(温度=0.0=0.0). 这种标准化设置确保了性能差异可归因于模型行为,而不是采样变异或即时工程.

blocks.en: Greedy decoding with temperature = 0.0 =0.0 provides deterministic, reproducible outputs and makes Pass@1 a measure of single-attempt performance. This policy keeps the benchmark focused on conditional editing rather than candidate search and reranking: each model receives the same information and produces one revision, while multi-round or test-guided selection systems require separate evaluation because they use additional attempts and feedback.
blocks.zh: 与温度相通的贪婪解码=0.0=0.0提供确定性,可再生的输出,并让Pass@1成为单试性能的度量. 这项政策将基准的重点放在有条件的编辑而不是候选人的搜索并重新排序上:每个模型都收到相同的信息并产生一个修订,而多回合或测试指导的选择系统则需要单独的评价,因为它们使用额外的尝试和反馈.

blocks.en: A.6 Full Language-wise Performance Results
blocks.zh: A.6 完全语文的成绩

blocks.en: Table 16: Full language-wise performance on LintEval for C++ and Python. All four metrics are reported; best results per column are in bold .
blocks.zh: 表16:C++和Python在LintEval上的完全语言智能性能. 所有四个衡量标准都报告;每栏的最佳结果用黑体表示。

blocks.en: Table 17: Full language-wise performance on LintEval (continued): Java. All four metrics are reported; best results per column are in bold .
blocks.zh: 表17: LintEval上的全语言性能(续): 爪哇岛. 所有四个衡量标准都报告;每栏的最佳结果用黑体表示。

blocks.en: Tables 16 and 17 present the complete language-wise performance breakdown with all four metrics for all evaluated models. The first table groups C++ and Python to support a direct comparison between the highest- and lowest-performing language settings, while the second isolates Java so that its New@P and edit-cost patterns remain readable without shrinking the columns. Pass@1 measures functionality preservation; the remaining metrics are conditioned on passing revisions, so they characterize the quality and efficiency of functionally valid edits rather than all generated outputs.
blocks.zh: 表16和17按语文分列了所有评价模型的全部四个衡量标准。 第一个表格分组C++和Python,支持对表现最高和表现最差的语言设置进行直接比较,而第二个表格将Java隔离,使其New@P和编辑成本模式保持可读性而不会缩小列. Pass@1测量功能保存;其余的度量标准以通过修改为条件,因此它们描述功能有效的编辑的质量和效率,而不是所有生成的产出.

blocks.en: Python presents the greatest challenge for open-source models. For example, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B achieves 67.6% Pass@1 on C++ but only 35.5% on Python, a gap of 32.1 percentage points. The same model shows 27.6% Reduction@P on C++ versus 19.0% on Python. This disparity likely reflects two factors: (1) Python’s dynamic typing and flexible syntax make semantic preservation harder to verify through static analysis, and (2) Pylint’s rule set includes many convention checks that require understanding of Python idioms (e.g., naming conventions, docstring requirements) which may not be well-represented in code generation training data.
blocks.zh: Python对开源模型提出了最大的挑战. 例如: Quen2.5-Coder-7B 实现 67.6% Pass@1 on C++,但Python只有35.5%,相差32.1个百分点. 同一型号显示为27.6%的减速@P上C++,而Python显示为19.0%. 这种差异可能反映了两个因素: (1)Python的动态打字和灵活的语法使得语义保存更难通过静态分析进行验证,(2)Pylint的规则集包括许多需要理解Python idioms(例如命名惯例,docstring要求)的常规检查,在代码生成培训数据中可能没有很好的代表.

blocks.en: Closed-source models (GPT-5.2, GPT-5.4-mini) maintain low New@P across all languages (0.9%–17.1%), while open-source models show higher variance. On Java, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B shows the highest New@P among the evaluated models at 42.4%, suggesting that while the model can reduce the original alerts, its edits frequently violate other PMD rules. This may reflect the model’s weaker familiarity with Java-specific conventions (e.g., exception handling patterns, access modifier usage) compared to C++ and Python.
blocks.zh: 闭源模型(GPT-5.2,GPT-5.4-mini)在所有语言中都保持了低等的New@P(0.9%–17.1%),而开源模型显示差异较大. 在Java上,Quen2.5-Coder-7B在被评价的模型中显示最高的New@P为42.4%,这表明虽然该模型可以减少原始的警报,但其编辑经常违反其他PMD规则. 这可能反映出模型较C++和Python对Java特定公约(如例外处理模式,访问修改器用法)的熟悉度较弱.

blocks.en: LinePerFix@P reveals a clear trade-off between lint reduction and edit minimality. GPT-5.4-mini achieves the lowest LinePerFix@P on Python (9.8) and Java (13.4), indicating efficient targeted edits. In contrast, Llama-3.2-1B shows LinePerFix@P of 28.1 on Java, suggesting that even when it fixes alerts, the edits are large and potentially disruptive.
blocks.zh: 线条PerFix@P 显示在减少lint和编辑最小度之间有明显的取舍. GPT-5.4-mini在Python(9.8)和Java(13.4)上实现了最低的LinePerFix@P,表示高效的目标编辑. 相形之下,Llama-3.2-1B在Java上显示LinePerFix@P为28.1,暗示即使它修正了警报,编辑量也很大并有可能造成干扰.

blocks.en: The language split confirms that aggregate performance is not representative of every analyzer–language setting. Closed-source commercial models retain strong alert reduction across all three languages, whereas open-source models lose substantially more ground on Python and Java and often introduce more new alerts there. C++ therefore provides the most stable setting in this benchmark, while robust Python and Java refactoring remains the clearest cross-language bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 语言分裂证实,总性能并不代表每个分析器语言设置。 闭源商业模型在所有三种语言中都保留了强烈的警报还原,而开源模型则在Python和Java上损失了多得多的地盘并经常在那里引入了更新的警报. C++因此在这个基准中提供了最稳定的设置,而强活的Python和Java重构仍然是最明显的跨语言瓶颈.

blocks.en: A.7 Category-wise Performance
blocks.zh: A.7 类别性能

blocks.en: Table 18: Category-wise performance for Error-prone, Performance, and Refactor alerts. Pass@1 is computed over samples having ≥ 1 \geq 1 alert in the category; Reduction@P and New@P aggregate over passed instances.
blocks.zh: 表18:易出错性能、性能和重感应警报的类别性能。 Pass@ 1 是在有 1\ geq 1 提醒的样本上计算出来的; 递减@ P 和 New@ P 汇总到过例中。

blocks.en: Table 19: Category-wise performance (continued): Style and Other alerts under the same aggregation protocol as the first part.
blocks.zh: 表19:按类别划分的性能(续):与第一部分相同的汇总协议下的样式和其他提醒.

blocks.en: Tables 18 and 19 report performance across the five alert categories. Error-prone, Performance, and Refactor are grouped in the first table because they more often require behavior- or structure-aware changes; Style and Other appear in the second table. The split is presentational only: both tables use the same samples and aggregation protocol. Pass@1 is category-specific because it is computed on files containing at least one alert from that category, while Reduction@P and New@P aggregate category alerts over the corresponding passed revisions.
blocks.zh: 表18和19报告五个警戒类别的业绩。 易出错,性能,和Refactor在第一个表格中被分组,因为它们更经常需要行为-或结构-意识的改变; Style and Other在第二个表格中出现. 拆分只是演示文稿:两个表格都使用相同的样本和汇总协议. Pass@1是特定类别,因为它是在包含该类别中至少一个提醒的文件上计算的,而Precut@P和New@P聚合类别则针对相应的通过的修订发出提醒.

blocks.en: Error-prone alerts (e.g., bugprone-* in clang-tidy) require semantic understanding of the code’s behavior. GPT-5.2 achieves 83.0% Reduction@P on Error-prone with 63.3% Pass@1, indicating that many fixes break functionality. Smaller models struggle more: Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B achieves only 3.5% Reduction@P on Error-prone, suggesting it either avoids fixing these alerts or fixes them incorrectly.
blocks.zh: 容易出错的警示(如:crange-tidy中的bugpoli- *)要求语义上理解代码的行为. GPT-5.2 实现 83.0% 减值@ P在易出错上,63.3% Pass@ 1 显示许多修正功能中断 。 更小的模型更挣扎: Wen2.5-Coder-0.5B在易出错上只实现3.5%的还原@P,建议它要么避免固定这些提醒,要么错误地修正.

blocks.en: Performance alerts (e.g., performance-unnecessary-value-param ) often map to well-known idioms: pass-by-reference instead of pass-by-value, avoid unnecessary copies, use efficient data structures. GPT-5.4-mini achieves 90.3% Reduction@P on Performance with 66.7% Pass@1, one of the best balances among all categories. This suggests that performance fixes are more mechanical and less semantically risky.
blocks.zh: 性能警示(如性能-不必要-值-param) 常被映射到出名的平面:通过比对而不是通过比对值,避免不必要的复制,使用高效的数据结构. GPT-5.4-小成绩 90.3% 业绩减少@P,通过率为66.7%,是所有类别中最好的平衡之一。 这表明性能修补更能机械化并降低体能风险.

blocks.en: Style alerts are numerous but fine-grained. Fixing one Style violation (e.g., variable naming) can easily introduce another (e.g., inconsistent naming across the file). Llama-3.2-3B shows 3.8% New@P on Style, among the highest for Style across models, confirming that Style fixes are prone to cascading violations.
blocks.zh: 样式提示很多,但精细。 修复一个Style违规(如可变命名)可以轻易地引入另一个(如整个文件的命名不一致). Llama-3.2-3B 显示 3.8% New@P on Style,属于Style跨模型最高之列,证实Style修饰容易出现串联违规.

blocks.en: No category is uniformly easy across model scales. Commercial models achieve high Reduction@P in every category, but Refactor remains comparatively difficult for GPT-5.2 (59.3%) and GPT-5.4-mini (72.5%). For open-source models, Performance is often more tractable than Error-prone, while Style exposes a sharp scale gap despite its high frequency. The category results therefore support a two-part requirement for effective refactoring: semantic control for behavior-relevant alerts and consistent file-wide editing for numerous local Style alerts.
blocks.zh: 任何类别都不可能在模型尺度上统一容易。 商业模式在每一类别中都实现了高减量@P,但对GPT-5.2(59.3%)和GPT-5.4-mini(72.5%)而言,Refactor仍然相对困难. 对于开源模型来说,性能往往比出错易被牵引,而Style尽管频率高,却暴露出巨大的尺度差距. 因此,分类结果支持有效重构的两部分要求:行为相关警报的语义控制以及众多本地Style提示的一致全文件编辑.

blocks.zh: A.8 警报计数分析

blocks.en: Tables 20 and 21 present performance across four alert-count tiers. The first table covers sparse files with 1 or 2–5 alerts, and the second covers denser files with 6–10 or more than 10 alerts. Comparing the same model across the two tables reveals whether additional alerts provide useful opportunities for coordinated cleanup or instead overload the model’s ability to preserve functionality and avoid collateral changes.
blocks.zh: 表20和表21列出四个警戒点的业绩。 第一表包含有1到2到5个提醒的稀有文件,第二表包含有6到10个或10个以上提醒的密集文件. 对两个表格的同一模型进行比较后发现,额外的警报是否为协调清理提供了有益的机会,或者是否使模型保留功能并避免附带变化的能力超负荷。

blocks.en: For stronger models, higher alert density reduces Pass@1 but increases Reduction@P: GPT-5.4-mini’s Pass@1 drops from 82.1% on single-alert files to 63.9% on files with > > 10 alerts (a decline of 18.2 percentage points), while Reduction@P rises from 62.5% to 92.1%. Open-source models often degrade instead: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B ’s Reduction@P drops from 62.9% to 17.0%, and Llama-3.2-1B ’s from 25.9% to − - 4.8%. This suggests that stronger models adopt a broader editing strategy to resolve clustered alerts in bulk, while weaker models lack the capacity to coordinate multiple fixes.
blocks.zh: 对于更强的模型,更高的警示密度会减少Pass@1,但会增加Precess@P:GPT-5.4-mini's Pass@1从单警示文件的82.1%下降到有 > 10个警示文件的63.9%(下降18.2个百分点),而Precess@P则从62.5%上升到92.1%. 开源模型往往会降解: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B的降幅@P从62.9%降至17.0%;Llama-3.2-1B的降幅从25.9%降至--4.8%。 这表明更强大的模型采取更广泛的编辑策略,以批量地解决集群警报,而更弱的模型则缺乏协调多处修正的能力.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B shows negative Reduction@P on files with > > 10 alerts (-4.1%), meaning it introduces more alerts than it fixes. This indicates that small models lack the capacity to reason about multiple interacting violations and instead make scattered edits that create new problems.
blocks.zh: Wen2.5-Coder-0.5B在有 > 10个提醒(-4.1%)的文件中显示负减@P,这意味着它引入的提醒比它修正的要多. 这表明,小模型缺乏对多重互动侵权行为进行推理的能力,而只是进行分散的编辑,从而造成新的问题。

blocks.en: For GPT-5.2, New@P drops from 35.5% on single-alert files to 6.3% on files with > > 10 alerts; a similar trend holds for GPT-5.4-mini. This may reflect a selection effect: files with many alerts are likely already low-quality, so models have more room to improve without triggering new violations. This trend does not hold consistently for open-source models: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B ’s New@P rises from 8.6% to 13.8%, and Llama-3.2-1B ’s from 11.1% to 17.0%.
blocks.zh: 对于GPT-5.2,New@P从单报警文件的35.5%下降到了带有 > 10个提醒文件的6.3%;GPT-5.4-mini也有类似趋势. 这可能反映出一种选择效果:许多警告的文件可能已经是低质量的,因此模型有更多的改进空间而不会引发新的违反. 这一趋势对开源模型来说并不一致: Wen2.5-Coder-7B的"New@P"从8.6%上升到了13.8%,而Llama-3.2-1B则从11.1%上升到了17.0%.

blocks.en: Alert density separates coordinated refactoring from isolated fixes. Strong models trade some functionality preservation for substantially greater alert reduction as density rises, whereas several small models approach zero or negative Reduction@P in the densest bin. More alerts are therefore not merely more instances of the same task: they change the required behavior from a local repair to a coordinated file-level transformation, which current smaller models do not perform reliably.
blocks.zh: 警报密度将协调重构与孤立的修复区分开来. 强力模型利用一些功能保全,随着密度的提高而大幅度地降低警惕,而几个小模型接近于零或负数 P在最密集的垃圾桶。 因此,更多的警示不仅仅是同一任务的更多实例:它们将所需的行为从局部修复改变为协调的文件级别转换,而目前较小的模型无法可靠地运行.

blocks.zh: A.9 SFT 软件 培训详情

blocks.zh: 表23:SFT培训数据统计。 本表只总结了修订格式的培训;该表保留在附录中,因为正文现在侧重于基准和评价表。

blocks.en: Table 23 presents the fine-tuning corpus: 1,196 problem instances sourced outside LintEval, with a distribution mirroring LintEval’s language proportions (C++ 538, Python 416, Java 242). The average alert count per sample (11.6) is comparable to LintEval’s average (13.1).
blocks.zh: 表23列出了微调程序:1,196个出自LintEval以外的问题实例,其分布反映了LintEval的语言比例(C++538,Python 416,Java 242)。 每个样本的平均警报计数(11.6)与LintEval的平均数(13.1)相当。

blocks.en: The corpus is separated from LintEval at the problem-instance level, so evaluation files are not reused as supervision examples. Matching the language proportions and approximate alert density reduces two obvious distribution shifts while leaving model family and supervision format as the controlled experimental factors. The corpus is not intended to reproduce every rule frequency exactly; instead, it supplies enough multilingual, multi-alert examples to compare how the same backbone responds to refactoring-oriented and generation-oriented objectives.
blocks.zh: 案卷与LintEval在问题处理层面相分离,因此评价文件不被再用作为监督实例. 匹配语言比例和近似警示密度会减少出两种明显的分布相变,同时留下模型家庭和监督格式作为被控制的实验因素. 教程并不是要完全照搬每个规则频率;相反,它提供了足够的多语种、多战备的例子,以比较同一主干如何对重构的面向一代的目标作出反应。

blocks.en: Table 22 decomposes fixed and newly introduced alerts for the 3B SFT variants. Note: it reports raw alert counts on the shared evaluation subset, not directly comparable to the percentage metrics reported for the SFT experiment in the main paper. A+L → \to A ′ fixes 2,453 alerts (vs. baseline 360) with 189 new alerts (Fix/New Ratio 13.0 × \times ), the most efficient among all formats. Q → \to A fixes only 281 alerts with 98 new alerts (Fix/New Ratio 2.9 × \times ), indicating minimal lint reduction progress. Q → \to A ′ fixes 304 alerts but introduces 585 new alerts, yielding the lowest Fix/New Ratio (0.5 × \times ), suggesting that generation-oriented supervision with purified targets can produce unstable new-alert behavior on this subset.

Q ~\to A 仅用98个新警报(Fix/New Proble 2.9 ×\times )修正了281个警报,表示最小的还原进度. Q →\to A 修正了304个警报,但引入了585个新的警报,得出了最低的"Fix"/"新比"(0.5 ×\times ),说明以纯化目标为方向的以代为导向的监管可以在这个子集上产生不稳定的新警报行为.

blocks.en: The raw-count view complements, rather than replaces, Reduction@P and New@P. It exposes the volume of edits behind each aggregate percentage and makes the asymmetry between fixing and introducing alerts concrete. A+L → \to A ′ produces both the largest number of fixes and the strongest fix-to-new ratio, whereas Q → \to A ′ introduces more alerts than it removes on this subset. This supports the interpretation that access to the original code and its lint feedback is essential for learning targeted transformations; exposure to cleaner target programs alone does not provide the same localization signal.
blocks.zh: 原始计数视图补充,而不是替换 Dreat@P和New@P. 它揭示了每个总百分比背后的编辑量,使固定和引入警报之间的不对称混凝土. A+L → \到 A → 既能产生数量最多的修正,又能产生最强的固定对新比率,而Q → 到 一个 ' 引入的警报比它移除的这个子集还要多. 这支持这样一种解释,即获取原始代码及其精密反馈对于学习有针对性的转变至关重要;光接触更清洁的目标程序并不能提供相同的本地化信号。

blocks.en: A.10 Qualitative Examples
blocks.zh: A.10 定性实例

blocks.en: The examples in this section are not intended to estimate aggregate performance. Instead, they make the three failure and success modes measured by LintEval concrete: a useful revision should remove the reported alert, preserve the original behavior, and keep the edit localized enough to avoid collateral violations. Read together, the examples show why lint alert reduction alone is insufficient as a quality criterion. A revision can be syntactically plausible and even pass a limited test while still failing to implement the intended semantic change.
blocks.zh: 本节中的例子无意估计总体业绩。 相反,它们使得由LintEval complete测量的三种失败和成功模式:一个有用的修改应该去掉所报道的警示,保留原始行为,并保持编辑的本地化,以避免附带侵权. 例子一并读取,说明为什么单靠降低警惕不足以作为质量标准。 修订在实际上是可信的,甚至通过有限的测试,同时仍未能实施预期的语义变化。

blocks.en: Linter: clang-tidy performance-unnecessary-value-param Original: void process(vector<int> data) { Revision: void process(const vector<int>& data) { Result: Alert resolved, functionality preserved, single-line edit.
blocks.zh: Linter: crang-tidy 性能-不必要-值-param 原始:无效进程(vector<int> data){订正:无效进程(const victor<int> data){ 结果:提醒解决了,功能保存了,单行编辑.

blocks.en: A targeted edit (pass-by-value → \to pass-by-const-reference) that resolves the alert without side effects. This example supports the conclusion that many Performance alerts are actionable through a localized, idiomatic transformation: the model changes the parameter representation while leaving the function’s observable behavior unchanged. It therefore illustrates the desired high-quality outcome measured jointly by positive Reduction@P, successful functionality tests, and low edit cost.
blocks.zh: 定向编辑(通过- by- value →\ to pass- by- const- reference),可以解决警报而无副作用. 这个例子支持一个结论,即许多性能警报可以通过一个局部的,平庸的转变来行动:模型改变参数代表,同时使函数的可观察行为不变. 因此,它显示了以正减@P、成功的功能测试和低编辑成本联合衡量的所期望的高质量结果。

blocks.en: Linter: Pylint unused-variable Original: 15-line function with one unused variable. Revision: 42-line rewrite of the entire function. Result: Original alert resolved, tests pass, but three new Pylint alerts introduced.
blocks.zh: Linter: Pylint 未使用的可变函数 原:15行有1个未使用的变量. 修订版:42行重写整个函数. 结果:原警示解除,测试通过,但引入了3个新的Pylint警示.

blocks.en: Instead of a targeted fix, the model rewrites the entire function, introducing new violations (e.g., naming conventions, missing docstrings). The conclusion is that over-editing creates a second source of risk even when the original alert disappears: a broad rewrite increases the surface area for new alerts and behavioral regressions. This is why New@P and LinePerFix@P complement Reduction@P, and why a model should not receive full credit for removing one alert if it does so by unnecessarily transforming the rest of the file.
blocks.zh: 模型不是定点固定,而是重写了整个功能,引入了新的违规行为(例如命名公约,缺失docstrings). 其结论是,过度编辑即使原始警报消失,也会产生第二个风险源:大改写会为新的警报和行为回归增加表面积. 这就是为什么New@P和LinePerFix@P补充Preduction@P,为什么一个模型如果通过不必要地转换文件的其余部分来删除一个提醒,就不应该获得完全的信用.

blocks.en: Linter: clang-tidy bugprone-integer-division Original: int result = a / b; (intended result is fractional). Revision: float result = a / b; Result: Integer division still performed; correct fix would promote an operand, e.g., (float)a / b.
blocks.zh: 线粒体: Clang- tidy bug 易分解 原文:int results = a / b; (意向结果为分数). 订正:浮点结果=a/b; 结果:整数师仍在执行;正确的修补将促进操作,例如(活体)a/b。

blocks.en: The model changes the storage type but misses that integer operands still produce integer division—illustrating why Error-prone alerts require semantic understanding beyond syntactic pattern matching. This example supports the conclusion that a superficially appropriate type change can leave the reported semantic defect untouched. Correctness depends on the types of the operands at the division operation, not only on the destination variable, so a reliable system must reason about evaluation semantics and test behavior rather than match the alert’s wording or alter a nearby declaration.
blocks.zh: 该模型改变存储类型, 但错过了整数操作仍然产生整数除法—— 模糊为什么易出错的提醒需要语义理解, 而不是同步模式匹配 。 这个例子支持这样的结论,即表面适当的类型变化可以使所报告的语义缺陷不受影响. 正确性取决于分区操作的操作类型,不仅取决于目的地变量,因此可靠的系统必须说明评价语义和测试行为的理由,而不是与警报的措辞相匹配或改变附近的声明.

blocks.en: Taken together, the three cases define a practical hierarchy of revision quality. The first is a minimal and semantically valid repair; the second removes an alert but incurs unnecessary collateral changes; the third appears plausible but fails to repair the underlying computation. They therefore motivate the benchmark’s joint evaluation design: Reduction@P captures alert removal among functionally passing outputs, New@P captures collateral lint damage, and LinePerFix@P captures edit efficiency. The qualitative evidence also explains why Error-prone and mixed-category instances remain difficult even when a model can identify the reported rule. Successful linter-guided refactoring requires the model to select the right code location, apply the smallest behavior-preserving transformation, and verify that the resulting program still computes the intended result.
blocks.zh: 这三个案例合在一起确定了修订质量的实际等级。 第一种是最低限度的、模拟有效的修复;第二种是去除警报,但发生不必要的附带变化;第三种似乎是可信的,但未能修复基本的计算。 因此,它们促使基准的联合评价设计: 减少@ P抓取功能传递输出中的提醒去除,New@P抓取附带的lint损坏,LinePerFix@P抓取编辑效率. 定性证据还解释了为什么即使一个模型能够确定所报告的规则,容易出错和混合类别的情况仍然很困难。 成功的l-指导重构需要模型选择正确的代码位置,应用最小的行为-保留转换,并验证产生的程序仍然计算出预期的结果.
